title: A launcher killed during the store-in-repair registration wait leaves its run unsettled
outcome: A launch interrupted while waiting out a store in repair ends as a settled failed run (no stages, no registration), or the docs state that a launch may block up to about 15 minutes before RUN or STARTED and should run in background mode.
acceptance: Either SIGINT or SIGTERM during the registration wait settles results.json as failed with no stages run and a reason naming the interrupted wait, shown by a behavioural test; or docs/test.md states that a launch may block that long before RUN/STARTED, including --detach launches, and should run in background mode.
